This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every year as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The Micro Ohmmeter PME-100 is designed for 
measuring the resistance of contacts on busbars and circuit breakers. The 
measurement is made at a high current, typically 100 amperes DC. The voltage 
drop across a contact under test is compared to the voltage drop across a known 
internal shunt resistance and the result is displayed.

The first draft initiated & tested at 
Elaasher 220 substation by eng. Ebraheem Hasan from Elaasher protection management, reviewed by protection manager 
eng. Fawzy Barakat, accepted by general 
manager eng. Elsaaied Nagy, revised by quality control manager eng. Mohamed 
Emran, approved by eng. Wageeh Mansy Head Sector of Protection, 
Measurements & Testes Canal Zone, and accepted by eng. Aly Attiah el Deib 
EETC Canal Zone MPIS Coordinator.

items:
Maintain always same polarity 
 (red current cable to red potential cable).

The instrument will give the 
 highest accuracy on the 50 and 100 ampere ranges, however the duty cycle at 
 this range is : one minute "on" & 10 minutes "off".

The instrument requires a 
 2-minute warm-up time to stabilize the metering circuit.

The breaker contacts are 
 generally in good condition if the obtained reading does not exceed 100 micro ohm.

Using the power cord, connect the instrument to 
 a suitable 220 Volt AC supply.

Plug in the heavy current cables (14m long) and 
 connect the two large clamps including the unknown resistance across the CB 
 contact terminals.

Connect the potential cables (14m long) as close 
 as possible to terminals of resistance under test, and Potential cables must 
 always be connected inside of the current cables as in figure (2).

Make sure that contact points are clean and 
 connections are well tight at both sides of the cables .

Select the 200 micro ohm range or 2000 micro ohm 
 range as required by measurements.

Turn the AC power switch ON, Turn the 100 A 
 switch ON.

Wait until the reading becomes stable and make 
 measurement by reading the display. The breaker contacts are generally in good 
 condition if the obtained reading does not exceed 100 micro ohm.

Turn the 100A switch OFF before disconnecting the 
 test cables and turn the AC power switch OFF.

Before closing the case, make sure that range 
 switch is left in the CHARGE position .
